sections.text: مقدمة

QAV is an analog 
input card (-50 to +50 mV) of six channels from thermocouple, and QRT is an 
analog input card (-50 to +50 mV) from RTD and of 4 channels.

This document 
outlines the testing procedures P1 for QAV, QRT carts, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
title block

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. Ahmed 
Esmail Fouad & eng. Khalil Ahmed Awwad, QAV
تم اختباره في 10 
Nov. 2002, QRT tested at 05 April 2003 and revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by general
director: eng Mohamed Abdel Ghafar, and approved by 
eng. Yosery 
Mohamed Salama Head Sector of EL-Aresh Power Station.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Steps to 
Prepare for test

Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU Cabinet.

In case of 
 QAV, use thermocouple in mV according to Temp. table (thermocouple type J)

In case of 
 QRT, use RTD في مصدر بالسيارات إلى درجة الحرارة. وفق Temp. 
 table (RTD)

Using 
 cabinet termination identify the location for the desired Card.

sections.text: Start Test

Using cabinet Termination list for each card Identify the input wires for the 
 first channel
Using the screw driver remove this two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the tester leads to the first channel .

في حالة QAV قم بحقن mV للقناة وفق 20 درجة مئوية، 50 درجة مئوية، 75 درجة مئوية، 100 درجة مئوية، 
 150 ج، 200 ج، 250 ج، 300 ج

In case of QRT inject mV to channel according to the 20 C , 100 C , 200 C , 
 300 C , 400 C , 500 C and 600 C

Compare the mV injected using radio with the mV reading in the central control 
 room (CCR) .

If the reading is Ok or within the range (- + 0.01mV), repeat steps for the 
 another channels .
إذا كانت هناك قراءة غير صحيحة لأي قناة في CCR، فاستبدل البطاقة.
